prompt: Which WCAG version does Section 508 incorporate, and is that changing soon?
assertions: States WCAG 2.0 Level AA, incorporated by the 2017 Revised 508 Standards
States it is not changing soon: no rulemaking is under way as of November 2026
Notes the October 2026 refresh-NPRM reports are erroneous, tracing to the 2015 proposal
Notes agencies may voluntarily exceed the baseline (WCAG 2.1/2.2) but the legal floor remains 2.0 AA
Distinguishes the adjacent DOJ and HHS rules that use WCAG 2.1 AA for different covered entities
